title: ever CORY|Illusion V-neck Short Sleeve Sequin Formal Maxi Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a dazzling entrance in this illusion V-neck sequin formal gown. This maxi dress features short sleeves and intricate sequin detailing that exudes glamour. Designed to elongate your silhouette, its flowing skirt pairs perfectly with the sparkling bodice. Whether for a gala, formal event, or black-tie wedding, this dress guarantees unforgettable moments.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
